records.source: It's a page from someone's diary...^^...There are only a few 'older' bachelors in town, and none of them are perfect! Harvey is really anxious and weak, but I know he would make a loyal and devoted husband. He likes coffee and pickles.^^Elliott is a bit foppish and melodramatic, but he does have a nice chin. He likes crab cakes and pomegranates.^^Shane is messy and anti-social. But I think his gruff exterior is a defense mechanism, insulating his softness from the world. He likes Beer, Pizza, and Pepper Poppers.%revealtaste:Harvey:395%revealtaste:Harvey:342%revealtaste:Elliott:732%revealtaste:Elliott:637%revealtaste:Shane:346%revealtaste:Shane:206%revealtaste:Shane:215
records.translation: Pahina ito mula sa talaarawan ng isang tao...^^...Kaunti lang ang “nakatatandang” binata sa bayan, at walang perpekto sa kanila! Talagang balisa at mahina si Harvey, pero alam kong magiging tapat at mapagmahal siyang asawa. Gusto niya ang kape at atsara.^^Medyo makisig manamit at madrama si Elliott, pero maganda naman ang baba niya. Gusto niya ang mga keyk ng alimango at mga granada.^^Magulo at ayaw makisalamuha ni Shane. Pero sa tingin ko'y pananggalang ang magaspang niyang panlabas na anyo, na nagkukubli sa malambot niyang kalooban mula sa mundo. Gusto niya ang Serbesa, Pizza, at Pritong Siling may Keso.%revealtaste:Harvey:395%revealtaste:Harvey:342%revealtaste:Elliott:732%revealtaste:Elliott:637%revealtaste:Shane:346%revealtaste:Shane:206%revealtaste:Shane:215

records.source: I've found some good things by looking in the garbage cans, on lucky days.^^Sometimes you'll find the 'dish of the day' behind the saloon... usually fresh!^^For dessert, I'll check the Mullners' can for cookies.^^For treasures, check the cans by the blacksmith and museum.
records.translation: Nakahanap ako ng ilang magagandang bagay sa paghahalungkat ng mga basurahan sa mga masuwerteng araw.^^Kung minsan ay makikita mo ang “putahe ng araw” sa likod ng saloon... karaniwan ay sariwa!^^Para sa panghimagas, tinitingnan ko ang basurahan ng mga Mullner para sa mga biskwit.^^Para sa mga kayamanan, tingnan ang mga basurahan sa tabi ng panday at Museo.
